items.title: Many rural N.S. families struggle to find child care, province remains committed to increasing access
items.description: Many families in Nova Scotia live in rural communities with very little access to child care. The provincial government says it remains committed to increasing access to daycare for all families, especially those in rural communities who have to drive long distances to find care.
